Oracle Corp. stock fell more than 3% in Thursday's premarket session as investors reassessed the software giant's aggressive AI spending strategy amid a mixed broader market. Nasdaq futures slipped 0.4%, while S&P 500 futures edged up 0.2%.

The decline comes as Oracle faces mounting scrutiny from investors and credit analysts over the financial risks tied to its rapid AI infrastructure expansion.

Debt-Funded AI Expansion Draws Scrutiny

Oracle has accelerated spending on AI data centers to expand its cloud business, but limited cash reserves have forced the company to rely heavily on debt financing and long-term lease commitments.

According to Reuters, Oracle ended fiscal 2026 with negative free cash flow, elevated capital expenditures and roughly $260 billion in data center lease obligations. In July, S&P Global Ratings downgraded Oracle's credit rating to BBB-, just one notch above speculative grade.

Moody's Ratings said other hyperscale cloud providers are also investing aggressively in AI infrastructure, but none are doing so with leverage and cash flow metrics as stretched as Oracle's. The agency also warned that Oracle's leverage could temporarily approach five times EBITDA.

Analysts Warn Of Additional Downgrade Risk

Credit analysts say Oracle's balance sheet could face additional pressure if leverage remains elevated.

S&P analyst Andrew Chang told Reuters another downgrade is possible if leverage stays above 4.5 times. Fitch Ratings has similarly warned that sustained leverage above its thresholds could result in negative ratings action.

Morgan Stanley credit analyst Lindsay Tyler said on a podcast that Oracle could end the year with two low-BBB credit ratings, increasing concerns over potential "fallen angel" status, although she views a move to high-yield debt as a medium-term risk rather than an immediate threat.

Meanwhile, Rothschild & Co Redburn analyst Alex Haissl, who rates Oracle Sell, told Reuters the market continues to assume the company's new data centers will be completed on schedule and generate the expected revenue and profits. He said he remains more cautious about the economics underpinning Oracle's cloud expansion.

周四盘前交易中，甲骨文公司股价下跌超过 3%，原因是投资者在大盘涨跌不一的情况下重新评估了这家软件巨头激进的人工智能支出策略。 纳斯达克期货下跌 0.4%，标准普尔 500 指数期货小幅上涨 0.2%。

此次下跌之际，甲骨文正面临投资者和信贷分析师对其人工智能基础设施快速扩张带来的财务风险的越来越严格的审查。

债务资助的人工智能扩张受到审查

甲骨文加快了人工智能数据中心的支出，以扩大其云业务，但有限的现金储备迫使该公司严重依赖债务融资和长期租赁承诺。

据路透社报道，甲骨文在 2026 财年结束时，自由现金流为负，资本支出增加，数据中心租赁债务约为 2600 亿美元。 7 月，标准普尔全球评级将甲骨文的信用评级下调至 BBB-，仅比投机评级高一级。

穆迪评级表示，其他超大规模云提供商也在积极投资人工智能基础设施，但没有一家公司的杠杆率和现金流指标像甲骨文那样捉襟见肘。 该机构还警告称，甲骨文的杠杆率可能暂时接近 EBITDA 的五倍。

分析师警告额外的降级风险

信贷分析师表示，如果杠杆率持续升高，甲骨文的资产负债表可能面临​​额外压力。

标准普尔分析师 Andrew Chang 告诉路透社，如果杠杆率保持在 4.5 倍以上，则可能会再次下调评级。 惠誉评级公司也发出类似警告，杠杆率持续高于阈值可能会导致负面评级行动。

摩根士丹利信贷分析师 Lindsay Tyler 在播客上表示，甲骨文可能会在年底获得两个低 BBB 信用评级，这增加了人们对潜在“堕落天使”地位的担忧，尽管她认为转向高收益债务是中期风险，而不是直接威胁。

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

与此同时，Rothschild & Co Redburn 分析师 Alex Haissl 对甲骨文的销售进行了评级，他告诉路透社，市场仍然认为该公司的新数据中心将如期竣工，并产生预期的收入和利润。 他表示，他对支撑甲骨文云扩张的经济状况仍然更加谨慎。
